scientific_integrity: Exact proof for positive finite bond activities on simple three-path theta networks; independent exact-rational checks support, not replace, the proof. An earlier equivalent or dominating result outside examined sources is not excluded.
scientific_limitations: One marked edge from each of exactly three terminal paths of length at least two
The q>2 single transition holds when all activities scale by one positive scalar, not for arbitrary multivariate trajectories
The theorem concerns finite graphs, not thermodynamic phase transitions or higher cumulants
title: Universal three-path cumulant reversal at the two-state Potts boundary
